goal: Append narrate(text, out_wav, voice, speed) to scripts/story_film.py. It runs the Kokoro voice container through subprocess.run and writes the returned WAV bytes to out_wav.
requirements: Edit scripts/story_film.py only. Add import json and import subprocess at the top if they are missing. Standard library only.
Signature: def narrate(text, out_wav, voice="am_michael", speed=1.0).
Call subprocess.run with the argv list ["docker", "run", "--rm", "-i", "maxh8086/voice:1", "/opt/venv-kokoro/bin/python", "/opt/voice-ui/kokoro_speak.py", "speak"].
Pass input=json.dumps({"text": text, "voice": voice, "speed": speed}).encode("utf-8"), capture_output=True and check=False.
If returncode is not 0, raise RuntimeError carrying the last line of stderr, decoded as UTF-8. Otherwise write stdout to out_wav in binary mode.
context: Add no tests and change no other file. Import check: callable(narrate) must be True when the module is imported from the repo root.
